_why: The multi-task replay bed. ONE task is not a bed: iterating on task 69 alone overfits to one A2A/MCP question, and the 100-task DRB-I bar cannot be approximated by it. Each entry pins a task to the cached estate that holds its acquired evidence, so an arm replays at ZERO Tavily and acquisition variance is held constant across arms.
_adding_a_task: Fly it once against the live web (this BILLS Tavily searches; fetches are free), then read the run id from the run dir and register dr-estate-dr-<run_id> here. An estate that no longer exists on disk must be REMOVED from this file rather than left to fail at run time - task 58 (dr-1787634076) was deleted and is why this file exists.
